statement: Paper C Lemma 4.1' (monotone pairing), with a corrected proof and the same constant. Hypotheses of Lemma 4.1 (steps in [a, b], 0 < a ≤ b ≤ 1/2, b ≤ 21a/20, (H−1) a ≥ 12) plus monotone steps: each half-cell colour receives at least H/3 − 2 terms, in both cell conventions. The proof printed until 2026-09-08 claimed every pair of consecutive cells (ρ, ρ') has min ≥ (ρ+ρ')/3, deduced from a step scale that 'drops by at most X/21 spread over the cells'; monotonicity does not give gradual change, and a = 10/41, b = 21/82 with points −2a, −a, 0, a, 2a, 2a+b, 2a+2b, … (nondecreasing steps) has the interior pair (3, 1), ratio 1/4. It also paired the two partial end cells as if interior. Corrected proof: (a) for interior i < j, ρ_j ≤ ρ_i + 1, because the ρ_i + 1 steps across cell i span more than 1/2 so one exceeds 1/(2(ρ_i+1)), every step inside cell j is at least that, and the ρ_j − 1 steps inside cell j span less than 1/2; (b) pair the interior cells consecutively, leave at most three cells (≤ 3G points) unpaired, so the scarcer colour has at least (H − 3G)/3 + S with S the surplus Σ (min − sum/3) over pairs, and it suffices that S ≥ G − 2; (c) G ≥ 7: 7g ≥ 5G so every pair has ratio ≥ 5/12 and S ≥ (H − 3G)/12 ≥ (21G − 23)/12 ≥ G − 2 using H ≥ 24G − 23; (d) 3 ≤ G ≤ 6, g ≥ 2: ratio ≥ 3/8 except (G, g) = (4, 2), where (a) gives {3,4}-pairs (≥ 3/7) before {2,3}-pairs (≥ 2/5) with at most one straddle, S ≥ (H − 18)/15 > 2; (e) G = 2: S ≥ 0; (f) G = 3, g = 1 (b > 1/4, 3b < 1, 7b < 2): after the first interior 1-cell all cells hold ≤ 2, adjacent (1,1) is impossible (three steps would span > 1), two consecutive pairs with six points are impossible (seven steps would span > 2), so any two consecutive {1,2}-pairs hold ≥ 7 points with ≥ 3 for the scarcer colour, S ≥ (H − 13)/15 − 1 ≥ 1. Adversarial search over 4.2 · 10^6 two-valued monotone profiles at 64 phases each (X ∈ [1, 6), b/a ∈ {1, 1.02, 1.04, 1.05}, all switch points and 64 phases): no violation, least slack 1.33 over H/3 − 2; fact (a) holds on every profile. Lemma 4.2 consumes the constant −2 verbatim, so nothing downstream changes. Kernel-checked in FateSweepMonotone.lean as sweep_monotone_cell, sweep_monotone_fract_lt_half, sweep_monotone_fract_ge_half, sweep_monotone_ceil, sweep_monotone_rep_le_half, sweep_monotone_rep_gt_half; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. Not a parity theorem about the map.
